question: ______ was awarded, Padma Shri in 1970 for his contribution to the field of Kuchipudi dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**V. Satyanarayana Sarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **V. Satyanarayana Sarma** was a renowned Kuchipudi dancer, known for his exceptional contributions to the art form.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious **Padma Shri in 1970** for his outstanding contributions to Kuchipudi dance.
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form originating from Andhra Pradesh, and V. Satyanarayana Sarma played a pivotal role in its promotion and global recognition.
 
• He is celebrated for his ability to blend traditional storytelling with intricate dance techniques, earning accolades both nationally and internationally.
 
• His dedication to the art form helped preserve and propagate Kuchipudi as one of India's major classical dance traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi Dance:**

 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, characterized by its graceful movements and strong connection to Hindu religious themes.
 
• It involves a combination of rhythmic footwork, expressive gestures, and storytelling through dance and drama.
 
• The dance form often features performances based on mythological narratives, particularly from the epics Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• Instituted in 1954, Padma Awards are among the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• They are categorized into three levels: Padma Vibhushan (highest), Padma Bhushan (second-highest), and Padma Shri (third-highest).
 
• Padma Shri is awarded for distinguished contributions in various fields such as art, literature, science, sports, and social service.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Kuchipudi Dancers:**
 
 
• Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma, a prominent figure in Kuchipudi, was known for his exceptional performances and dedication to the art form.
 
• Other legendary Kuchipudi artists include Padma Subrahmanyam, Yamini Krishnamurthy, and Raja and Radha Reddy, who have also contributed to the popularity of the dance form globally.
 
 
 
• **Recognition of Indian Classical Dance:**
 
 
• India has eight recognized classical dance forms: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, and Sattriya.
 
• These dance forms are integral to India's cultural heritage and are celebrated for their unique styles and techniques.
